title: Store Counter Terms for Goods Held on a Northbeam Purchase Order
content:
Under Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment the hold days are the days the goods are held in store for
collection, the storage charge is the charge for each day the goods are held beyond those hold days, and the identity
column states whether photographic identity is checked at collection. Each fulfilment service sets its own.

| Fulfilment service | Days held in store for collection | Storage charge for each day beyond the hold days | Photographic identity checked at collection |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Parcel Delivery | 0 | 0.00 | no |
| Store Pickup Hold | 7 | 0.00 | yes |
| Threshold Delivery | 0 | 0.00 | no |
| Room of Choice Delivery with Haul Away | 0 | 0.00 | no |
| White Glove Delivery and Installation | 0 | 0.00 | no |
| Business Dock and Freight Delivery | 3 | 45.00 | yes |

Two of the six services hold goods at all: Store Pickup Hold for 7 days and Business Dock and Freight Delivery for 3
days. Those same two are the services at which photographic identity is checked at collection.

## The daily charge worked through (hypothetical days)

The storage charge attaches to each day beyond the hold days. On Business Dock and Freight Delivery, whose hold is 3
days and whose daily charge is 45.00, goods still at the counter on the fifth day have been held two days beyond the
hold days, which at 45.00 for each such day gives 90.00; four days beyond gives 180.00. On Store Pickup Hold the
daily charge is 0.00, so days beyond its 7 day hold carry no charge.
